decisions.details: Green (#00ff41) added as the single accent on the monochrome base. Hero digital-rain canvas, blinking cursor, terminal prompt markers. Hero typewriter loops. Name set to KARYLLE VIDAL.
Hash-based routing (useHashRoute). Home = hero only; About/Projects/Contact are separate pages. Dark mode only. Green matrix rain.

GlitchMatrixBackground (useGlitchMatrix hook) rendered ONLY on route '/'. Layers: faint green grid base, matrix rain canvas (katakana/digits/symbols, neon green, bright head, fading trail, ~30fps), green noise grain flicker, periodic glitch tears + RGB split + dropouts, SVG feDisplacementMap warp, CRT scanlines, radial vignette, text backdrop. Cursor-proximity brighten (disabled on touch). ENTER SYSTEM triggers a glitch burst before navigating. prefers-reduced-motion shows a static dim frame. Pauses on tab-hidden and off-screen (IntersectionObserver). DPR + resize handled. Other pages (Work/About/Contact) unchanged.

decisions.choice: Projects page: hacker terminal / project database
decisions.details: Near-black bg (#050505) with fixed faint green grid (GridBackground). Neon green #00ff41 accents, off-white #f2f2f2 headings. Oxanium (weights 300-500, font-display) for display headings and project titles, uppercase. 'Courier New', Courier, monospace (font-mono) for nav, labels, descriptions, tags. Section header [02] WORK_ARCHIVE / SELECTED PROJECTS. Hero: PROJECT DATABASE label, huge PROJECTS heading, description. Vertical project list (ProjectRow) with index, category+year, title, description, TagChips, arrow. Hover: border brightens, title green glow, arrow shifts. SYSTEM ONLINE nav indicator. Projects data now has id/category/year/title/description/tags[]/url. Seeded: 90 Legends, Malinta-Connect, ShoeSpot.
